proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : properUnitaryDivisors 0 = ∅ := by
    rw [properUnitaryDivisors]
    -- We need to show that the set {d ∈ Finset.Ico 1 0 | d ∣ 0 ∧ d.Coprime (0 / d)} is empty.
    -- Since Finset.Ico 1 0 is empty, the set is automatically empty.
    have h₂ : Finset.Ico 1 0 = ∅ := by
      -- Prove that Finset.Ico 1 0 is empty.
      simp [Finset.Ico_eq_empty_of_le]
    -- Now we can rewrite the set using h₂.
    rw [h₂]
    -- The set {d ∈ ∅ | ...} is empty because there are no elements in ∅.
    simp
  -- The final result follows from h₁.
  exact h₁
